key_findings: Narrative review integrating CGRP gene processing, CLR-RAMP1 receptor structure, cAMP-PKA/MAPK/calcium signaling and gepant and antibody therapeutics in migraine.
Beyond migraine, CGRP roles in chronic pain, osteoarthritis, cancer and neurodegeneration remain largely preclinical.
